subject: Change my site logo
body: Hi, how do I replace the logo at the top of my directory site? I have a new PNG. - Priya

subject: Adding membership plans
body: Hello, I want to offer a free plan and a paid plan to members. Where do I set that up?

subject: Edit email templates
body: Can I change the welcome email that new members get? I want to add our phone number.

subject: Custom domain
body: We bought a domain from GoDaddy. How do I point our site to it?

subject: Hide a menu item
body: How can I remove the Blog link from the main menu?

subject: Export my members
body: Need a list of all members as a spreadsheet for our accountant. Is there an export?

subject: Change colors
body: How do I change the main color of the buttons to match our brand?

subject: Categories for listings
body: How do I add new categories so members can pick them when they list their business?

subject: Approve listings manually
body: I don't want new listings to go live automatically. Can I approve each one first?

subject: Add a payment gateway
body: We want to accept cards. How do I connect Stripe to the site?

subject: SEO title
body: Where can I set the page title and description for Google?

subject: kaise karein
body: Mujhe apni site pe naya page banana hai, about us wala. Kahan se banate hain?

subject: Payments not going through
body: Since yesterday members get an error when they pay for a plan. We lose sales every hour. Please help!

subject: Emails not arriving
body: Our members say they don't receive the confirmation email. I checked spam too.

subject: Images won't upload
body: When I upload a photo for a listing it spins forever and then says failed.

subject: Search shows nothing
body: The site search returns zero results even for businesses I can see on the site.

subject: Login loop
body: Members log in, then get sent back to the login page again and again.

subject: Mobile menu broken
body: On iPhone the menu button does nothing. Desktop is fine.

subject: Site slow
body: Pages take about 10 seconds to load since last week. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Map not showing
body: The map on listing pages is gray and shows 'for development purposes only'.

subject: Can't reset password
body: I click reset password but never get the link. I need into the admin urgently.

subject: Admin hacked?
body: Someone changed our homepage text and I did not do it. Our admin password may be leaked.

subject: Add booking feature
body: Can you build a booking system so members' customers can book appointments with them?

subject: Custom member dashboard
body: We want a custom dashboard showing each member their profile views and leads. Is that possible?

subject: Integrate with our CRM
body: We use HubSpot. Can new member signups be pushed there automatically?

subject: Better search + AI
body: Our search isn't great. We want filters and maybe some AI. Can you do it?

subject: Migrate from WordPress
body: We have 2,000 listings on WordPress. Can you move them to your platform?

subject: Multi-language
body: We need the site in English and Spanish. What would that involve?

subject: Cancel my plan
body: Please cancel my subscription today and refund this month. We are not using it.

subject: Charged twice
body: I see two charges of the same amount on my card for March. Please refund one.

subject: Refund after 40 days
body: I signed up 40 days ago and forgot to cancel. Can I get my money back for the 2 months?

subject: Close my account
body: Close my account and delete all my data. Also confirm no more charges.

subject: Downgrade
body: I want to move to the cheaper plan from next month. Will I get a partial refund?

subject: chargeback
body: If you don't refund me today I will do a chargeback with my bank.

subject: Update broke our site
body: Your latest update broke our whole site layout. This is unacceptable. We are a paying customer for 3 years.

subject: Support too slow
body: I waited 5 days for an answer to a simple question. Terrible service.

subject: Wrong information
body: Your support told me the feature exists, I built my business around it and it does not. I'm furious.

subject: Thinking of leaving
body: Honestly we are considering switching to a competitor. Too many bugs lately.

subject: Rude agent
body: The person I chatted with yesterday was rude and dismissive.

subject: Lost leads
body: Your outage cost us leads for two days. What are you going to do about it?

subject: Price for custom design
body: How much would it cost to redesign our homepage?

subject: Quote for 5 landing pages
body: We need 5 landing pages in the same style. Please send a quote and timeline.

subject: Enterprise pricing
body: We have 50,000 members. Do you have a special plan and what does it cost?

subject: Cost of migration
body: What would you charge to import our old member database?

subject: Hourly rate
body: What is your hourly rate for small customisations?

subject: Re: my request
body: Hi, did you receive my request from last week about the payment error? No reply yet.

subject: Any update?
body: Following up on the quote you promised on Monday.

subject: Re: Re: logo
body: Thanks, that worked for the logo. One more question: can it also change in the footer?

subject: Still not fixed
body: You said the email problem was fixed but it is still happening.

subject: Waiting
body: Just checking you got the files I sent for the migration.
